title: Fifth pillar of Islam – Hajj
intro: Visiting the Ka‘bah and the holy places at a set time – once in a lifetime, for whoever is able.

learn.html: The fifth Islamic duty is Hajj. Hajj means visiting the Ka‘bah and the other holy places at an exact time. The rites of Hajj are done from the 9th to the 13th of Dhul-Hijjah – the day before and the days of Eid al-Adha.
Every Muslim man and woman must do Hajj once in a lifetime, if they can pay for the journey and support their family until they come back.

learn.text: The three fard parts of Hajj

items: Ihram – making the intention to enter the rites of Hajj, while saying the talbiyah
Standing at ‘Arafat – the pilgrims stay on the plain of ‘Arafat on the 9th of Dhul-Hijjah
Tawaf – going around the Ka‘bah seven times, after dawn on the first day of Eid al-Adha (tawaf al-ifadah)

learn.label: The talbiyah
learn.ar: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
learn.tr: Labbaykallaahumma labbayk. Labbayka laa shareeka laka labbayk. Innal-hamda wan-ni‘mata laka wal-mulk. Laa shareeka lak.
learn.en: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. All praise and blessings are Yours, and the dominion. You have no partner.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “For an accepted Hajj there is no reward except Jannah.” (Tirmidhi)

At ‘Arafat the pilgrims wear the white ihram: clean, white, unsewn clothing of two pieces for men; for women, the ihram is their usual modest clothing. Hajj time is also Eid al-Adha, when those not on Hajj offer a qurbani (sacrifice) to Allah. On the journey, pilgrims also visit the Prophet’s Masjid in Madinah and other holy places.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: One of the conditions for a valid Hajj is going around the Ka‘bah – tawaf – seven times.
